info.description: Three pictures scattered over one another, beside words.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Layout
edit.description: Which side the stack sits on, from 1024 pixels wide.

edit.label: Images
edit.description: Exactly three. The first sits at the top left, the second at the right, the third across the middle.

edit.label: Content
edit.description: What sits beside the stack. Its top lines up with the top of the middle picture rather than with the middle of the stack.
